title: Digital Marketing Assistant Manager
description:
What Sets Us Apart

At MHA, people come first, our colleagues, our clients, and the communities we support. Were ranked as number 11 in the UK s top accountancy firms and a proud member of Baker Tilly International, the world's 8th largest network, we combine global insight with a strong local commitment.

Our people-centred approach is what truly makes us different. You will be welcomed as a valued member of a collaborative, purpose-led team. We are committed to continuous learning, growth, and creating an environment where everyone can thrive.

We invest in our colleagues because they are the foundation of our shared success. With access to resources and award-winning development programmes, you will have the space to shape your career while making a real impact.

We are proud to hold the Investors in People Gold award, recognising our commitment to supporting, developing, and valuing every individual.

Here, You'll Go Beyond Numbers

We're looking for a Digital Marketing Assistant Manager who thrives on variety, enjoys a fast-moving environment, and wants their work to make a real difference

At MHA, you will be surrounded by passionate professionals who are committed to making a difference. Your work in Marketing will go beyond the numbers, it's about building trusted relationships, understanding their requirements, navigating risks, and delivering insights that support informed decision-making.

What You'll Be Doing

This is a position within the Digital Marketing team, reporting into the Senior Digital Marketing Manager. You will line manage junior members of the team, whilst helping to lead delivery across our four brands and their markets: MHA UK, Baker Tilly Ireland, Baker Tilly South East Europe and MHA UAE.

Leadership & people
- Support and develop junior members of the digital marketing team, holding regular one-to-ones and owning their appraisals and development.
- Review work and provide timely, constructive feedback.
- Plan and allocate work with the Senior Digital Marketing Manager to help set workflows and tasks across the team so the right people are on the right tasks, keeping deadlines realistic and workloads manageable.
- Coach and build capability in others, setting the standard in the team by how you operate.

Campaigns & projects
- Oversee digital campaigns from concept through to delivery across multiple channels and markets, keeping brand messaging consistent and correctly targeted.
- Own digital projects from start to finish, coordinating internal and external resource, and taking accountability for delivery.
- Take ownership of a specialist digital area within the digital function, leading its plan and answering for its results.
- Join up delivery with other specialists teams, such as creative and comms.

Channels & digital operations
- Support on day-to-day delivery across the full digital mix: the brand websites, organic and paid social, paid search, email, content and UX.
- Keeping lead trackers and digital documentation accurate and making sure digital practice stays on brand and compliant with GDPR.
- Resolve and support on day-to-day issues, knowing when to escalate where a decision needs to sit above you.

Performance, Analytics and Reporting
- Analyse large data sets and translate findings into clear commercial insights and actionable recommendations for stakeholders across the firm.
- Use performance data to optimise campaigns, demonstrating ROI and year-on-year improvement against key metrics.
- Take ownership of regular reporting within your area, supporting monthly and quarterly updates for the Senior Digital Marketing Manager and Partners.

Growth and Commercial Impact
- Play a key role in campaign planning for priority sectors and service lines, identifying opportunities to maximise digital performance and commercial outcomes.
- Support business development and lead generation through digital channels, improving both the volume and quality of inbound enquiries.
- Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders, gaining a deep understanding of their objectives to deliver effective, results-driven campaigns.

Brand and Governance
- Act as a brand guardian across all digital activity, ensuring content consistently reflects the Baker Tilly brand values and messaging.
- Champion digital best practice, ensuring accessibility, compliance, and governance requirements are met.
- Contribute actively to internal marketing committees, helping to drive positive change and continuous improvement across the team.

What we are looking for
- An experienced digital marketing professional with a proven record of planning and delivering campaigns that achieve ROI.
- Well informed across the digital marketing mix, spanning web, organic and paid social, paid search and email, with the ability to adapt tone of voice for different markets and audiences.
- Experience of managing high-budget SEO and PPC campaigns, from keyword strategy and bid management through to performance tracking.
- Experience of improving customer journeys and conversion across websites, including CRO, landing page and form optimisation.
- The ability to develop and oversee complex campaigns from concept to execution.
- Some experience of line management, or the readiness and judgement to take it on and develop more junior colleagues.
- Strong commercial and analytical judgement, comfortable turning data into decisions.
- Confident with stakeholders and credible enough to influence at a senior level.
- Degree level or equivalent in a marketing or business related subject, or equivalent experience.
- A driving licence and access to a car.
- Familiarity with the digital marketing tool stack, including analytics, social management and paid media platforms.

title: TikTok Content Creator & Live Host
description:
TikTok Content Creator & Live Host

Liverpool - Hybrid Working

Salary up to 35k - Depending on Experience

Working for a successful consumer wholesale business, this is a highly visible role focused on growing TikTok Shop revenue through a combination of short-form content creation and live commerce. The successful candidate will be the on-camera face of the brand, creating engaging TikTok content and hosting live shopping events that drive sales and audience growth.

Responsibilities:

Live Hosting
- Host regular TikTok Shop live selling sessions
- Demonstrate products and answer customer questions in real time
- Drive sales, engagement, and conversions during live streams
- Build a consistent live audience and community
- Analyse performance metrics including GMV, CTR, viewers, and conversion rates

Content Creation
- Create, film, edit, and publish TikTok videos
- Produce content such as:
- Product demonstrations
- Tutorials
- Unboxings
- Trend-led content
- Manage content calendars aligned with launches and promotions
- Set up basic filming environments and source props/samples

Growth & Performance
- Track engagement and sales performance
- Optimise content based on analytics
- Support seasonal campaigns, flash sales, and affiliate activity
- Stay current with TikTok trends and TikTok Shop developments

Collaboration
- Work closely with ecommerce and marketing teams
- Support influencer and affiliate partnerships
- Ensure TikTok activity aligns with wider brand campaigns

Skills Required:
- Must have previous experience working in a similar TikTok/Content Creator/Social Media role
- Confident and engaging on-camera presence
- Experience creating TikTok, Reels, or other short-form video content
- Basic video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere Rush, etc.)
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Commercial mindset with the ability to sell products effectively
- Self-motivated and comfortable working to a live broadcast schedule
- Experience working with retail beauty brands or haircare products
- Previous TikTok Live hosting experience
- TikTok Shop experience
- Live commerce or social selling experience
- QVC-style presenting background
- Existing TikTok following
- Experience analysing content performance metrics

This role is best suited to a commercially minded content creator who enjoys being on camera and can combine entertaining content with sales-driven live commerce.

title: Digital Analyst / Senior Digital Analyst
company: Harnham - Data & Analytics Recruitment - Agency - Permanent
description:
We're hiring for two Digital Analyst positions within a growing Customer & Digital Analytics team for a major UK retailer.

Whether you're an early-career analyst looking to develop your digital analytics skills or an established analyst ready to take on more ownership and stakeholder responsibility, there are opportunities at both levels. These hires are for an established team supporting eCommerce, customer experience, and digital performance.

The company

A large UK retail business investing heavily in data and analytics across customer, digital, and data science functions.

The digital analytics team sits within a wider central analytics capability and works closely with eCommerce, UX, Product, and Marketing teams to understand customer behaviour and improve online performance.

The role

You'll help the business understand how customers interact with its digital platforms and identify opportunities to improve performance across the customer journey.

Typical questions include:
- Why is basket value increasing or decreasing?
- Which acquisition channels are performing best?
- How are customers navigating the website?
- Which categories are driving growth?
- What impact are website and UX changes having on customer behaviour?

You'll use digital and website analytics data to support decision-making across eCommerce and customer experience teams.

What you'll be doing
- Analyse customer and website behaviour data
- Use SQL to interrogate large datasets
- Work with GA4 and digital performance data
- Build and maintain reports and dashboards
- Support website optimisation and UX initiatives
- Monitor basket value, conversion, customer journeys, and channel performance
- Deliver actionable recommendations to stakeholders
- Partner with eCommerce, Product, and Digital teams on business-critical projects

For the Senior Digital Analyst role, there will be a much stronger focus on:
- Stakeholder management
- Insight generation
- Commercial recommendations
- Driving action from analysis

What they're looking for Digital Analyst

Up to £37,000
- 1-2 years' experience in analytics
- SQL experience
- Experience working with digital, customer, or website data
- Strong analytical mindset
- Good communication skills
- Experience with GA4 or similar tools is beneficial

Senior Digital Analyst

Up to £45,000
- 2+ years' experience in Digital Analytics
- Strong SQL skills
- Experience analysing website and customer behaviour
- Strong stakeholder and insight delivery skills
- Ability to translate data into clear commercial recommendations
- Confidence presenting findings to different business teams

Highly desirable experience
- Retail or eCommerce backgrounds
- GA4
- BigQuery
- Digital performance analysis
- Conversion and customer journey analysis
- UX and testing analytics
- Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualisation tools

Why join?
- Join a mature analytics function with strong leadership
- Work on high-traffic eCommerce platforms
- Exposure to Product, UX, Marketing, and eCommerce teams
- Strong opportunity for career development
- Fast interview process
- Genuine influence on customer experience and digital performance

Interview process

Single-stage interview
Fast feedback and decision-making process

If you're a Digital Analyst with strong SQL skills and experience exploring customer behaviour, website performance, and digital journeys, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Digital Content Officer
description:
Digital Content Officer

£31,638-£34,637 Per annum

Liverpool

Full-Time

Permanent

It's an exciting time to join Career Connect. And we're looking for a creative Digital Content Officer to help us tell our story.

We're proud to have been named Careers Provider of the Year.

Our growth and digital transformation strategies are well underway, and we're looking for a proactive digital content specialist to help us grow our visibility and engagement.

As Digital Content Officer, you'll bring together high-quality content creation, strong technical and analytic skills, and the ability to apply insights.

We'd love to hear from you if you are:
- Passionate about finding and telling stories that inspire
- Excited about exploring new digital channels and creating engaging platform-specific content including video
- Experienced in creating and executing multi-channel digital campaigns, using analytics to measure impact, and applying insights to increase engagement
- An excellent writer, with skills in SEO and GEO
- Experienced in day-to-day website management
- Able to create integrated user journeys, including CRM
- Eager to empower colleagues to create their own content
- Experienced working within and across teams

Our Digital Content Officer will play a key role in helping our charity break down barriers and reach even more people with our life-changing services.

We'd love you to join us on this journey.

Qualifications

2 years + experience of website management

Proven experience in digital content creation

The closing date for this vacancy is 07-Sep-2026

Interviews are expected to take place 18th - Sept, 21st -Sept and 25th -Sept 2026
